reviews.text: Good experience. And fast. Helped me with my budget. I would 100% return every time for my pet. Recommend those who struggle for pet care.
I felt informed and my Magnus was not put through unnecessary procedures.

Dr. R and his staff were wonderful during our appointment! My dog is anxious and they were all understanding and made us feel comfortable the whole time. It’s always nice to not feel judged when you go to a vet and your dog isn’t on his best behavior. Dr R sat with us and talked in detail about everything and answered all my questions. The nurses were so nice and went into even more detail about vaccines and made sure I knew exactly what to do with his treatments. The place is very clean and there aren’t a lot of animals there so you don’t have to worry about a crowded waiting room. Also, drive past the building and turn into the alley and there’s a few parking spaces for the office!! I highly recommend Dr. R and feel like I’ve found a great vet for Cruz going forward.

We’ve been going to this vet for over 7 years now and we love their team. Everyone is so friendly and helpful and the vets are extremely kind and knowledgeable. We will keep coming here for as long as we have pets in the city

My French bulldog Bob went to Your Pet’s Wellness since he was 8 weeks old until I lost him last November at 13+ years. Throughout all those years, he received great veterinary care from Dr. Miller, Dr. Stricker, and Dr. Konishi. Beyond that, he received so much love from the entire staff that he would get very excited every time we went. He knew exactly where the treats were stored in the exam rooms and was very vocal letting everyone know he wanted some.

The last several months of his life were very difficult, but the kindness of the entire staff, and in particular Dr. Konishi, made things a little bit easier. Thanks for all the great care and love for Bob throughout the years. When I am ready to get another dog, I will certainly be taking him or her to Your Pet’s Wellness.
Thanks for the 5-star rating! Your trust and support mean a lot to our team.
Wonderful veterinarian. Very thorough. Answered all our questions and provided printouts! Highly recommend.

SHOUTOUT TO MELISSA! Every single time I need to take my 11 year old spicy cat, I ask for Melissa. She has so much patience and is the best at her job! Super helpful staff, clear communication, and supportive when it comes to taking the best care of your fur baby! If you needed a sign to make an appointment, THIS IS IT!
Dr. Itescu is great; I’ve been taking my dog for years and I have years of notes. They’ve always taken my concerns seriously.

I had a great experience here overall. The receptionist and technician were very helpful. Dr. R is extremely knowledgeable and explained medical information thoroughly. They were transparent about treatment options and price which is always appreciated and can be hard to find. I would recommend any pet owners visit Your Pets Wellness for any veterinary needs.

Took my baby girl, Jayda, to Your Pets Wellness for the first time yesterday. She is a very vocal and anxious girl and they were great with her. Cheyenne and the team were patient and reassuring. Dr. R explained things thoroughly. I highly recommend y.p.w!
Your review is appreciated. Thank you for sharing your experience with Your Pets Wellness (Bucktown).
I took my son Flynn here and they were absolutely amazing. Great people and very sanitized! I found my new vet , thank you Shyanne and Dr. R
Very friendly, prompt and helpful! I will continue to bring my animals here!
The staff is very helpful and super gentle with the patients.

Highly recommend this vet for all pet owners! The staff were so friendly and helpful with our new puppy, Rocco. They really took their time to make sure he was comfortable for his first vet appointment making it an easy and positive experience for him. As pet owners the staff explained everything thoroughly and clearly for us making sure we were aligned on his diet and shot schedule for the next couple of months.

I started bringing my dog piper here in April. She has recently gotten a tooth extracted and I had a wonderful experience. The staff and doctors are all incredibly friendly and warm, and they worked with me and my schedule to get my pet seen on time and schedule her surgery (even though they usually don’t do surgeries on the day I needed). Overall I felt accommodated and my pet was well cared for and I recommend this practice highly!

I’ve been going to Your Pets Wellness since Dr Dory owned the practice. While there’s been some changes and new faces at YPW as they adjust to new ownership, I still really have enjoyed my experiences as a client there. The front desk folks are always so friendly and welcoming, and they get me into a room almost immediately (never had to wait more than a couple mins) . The vets that I’ve seen since the ownership change (Dr R and Dr K) have both been great. Very good with my cat, gentle but effective (she squirms a lot during exams) They always explain any procedures/medical expenses fully and effectively. I have never felt ripped-off, as some folks in the reviews have said. I always feel like the costs of my visit are fair and transparent. My poor cat throws up in her carrier sometimes and they ALWAYS clean her up and give her a fresh towel in the carrier for the ride home. It’s the simple things that make us feel cared for.! I’m grateful to YPW for all their help in keeping my fur baby healthy!!!

We go here specifically to see Dr. Konishi, she is so sweet and kind and caring to our dog Smudge. We like how she calls our god “Good baby” and tells us we are good dog owners. We respect and trust her recommendations for care for our dog and hope to have her as our vet for many years to come.

So grateful how close we live to this vet because we have always had such a wonderful experience. My dog literally runs to pet wellness because she enjoys it so much. They are always super flexible with appointments with same days all the time. They always call and check in after appointments too. Staff and vets are sooo caring and gentle with my dog too. I would recommend this vet to anyone!
Super helpful. My cat didn’t even flinch while getting her vaccines. They explained everything in detail.
Very helpful and appreciative of my dogs healthcare needs. Prices are very fair and they are willing to meet within your budget. Overall great experience.

My Experience coming to this vet pet shop has been good, I toke my pet here & Doctor Konishi attend my pet & me & family so well she is so polite & attend us with the service that my pet need she welcome him with loving arms. I will recommend anyone that is looking for a vet pet shop to come here at Your Pets Wellness Professional Veterinary Care.
Thanks For Your Service
Your Pets Wellness Vet Shop. ☺️
The staff here are incredible and have taken such good care of my cat! I highly recommend
The staff were friendly and great with my cat! There's on site parking and we were in and out quickly.

Dr. Itescu and his entire staff were wonderful when I brought in my ailing cat. He explained what was causing her lethargy and listened to my questions so I could make an informed decision for her welfare. Later, when I made the heartbreaking decision to let her go, everyone was so genuinely kind and caring. I truly appreciated it during such a difficult time.

I’ve been taking my cats here since 2020 and have seen a definite improvement in care over the last few years. Dr Konishi is very thorough and really cares about my cats’ well being! The entire staff is friendly and responsive.

I love this vet! The doctor explained things very clearly and gave me tips on desensitizing my new pup to loud noises. The tech then gave me all of my options for care and treatments. The entire staff is very knowledgable and so kind. I'm grateful to have found a place nearby. They are on the pricier side of pet care, but with the expertise and care from the staff, it's worth it.
We are thrilled to receive your 5-star rating! Your trust in our pet care means everything to us.

I love this place! It is very easy to book appointments online. Tstaff here is incredibly friendly and provide great feedback and support. My dog gets SO excited to go in there. We always leave so happy everytime!
My sweet nervous boys are treated with so much love and care ❤️
I had a great experience here! Everyone is friendly and they are upfront with all costs associated with my visit. They took good care of my buddy.

The team here is so amazing. Melissa handle my aggressive kitty beautifully for his nail trim. Dr. Konishi was very considerate of my other cat; we decided to wait until his dental to collect urine, as he has a broken hip. I will continue to bring my creatures here.

I’ve been bringing my dog here for about 6 years now, and there’s no where else I’d go! My German shepherd has always been anxious around new people and places, but the staff is always so gentle, patient, and they do their best to create a comfortable environment. The team also makes the process of the appointment as efficient and straightforward; pre check in, explaining diagnostics and prices with you. Definitely recommend!

This was my first time visiting Your Pets Wellness & unfortunately it will also be my last. I can in for my cat having GI issues, explained that this was a recurring issue I’ve managed before but usual course of action wasn’t doing it this time. The bedside manner of the woman who helped me was patronizing and dismissive. My cat who didn’t feel well and was nervous, was put on the ground to walk around so she could explore, she then rubbed onto the woman’s leg because she was starting to warm up! Unfortunately because she was having tummy issues she needed to be groomed, this women pushed her away with her foot and said “Ew, gross” LOL… like why do you work at a vets office then? She just freaked her out more.

Then it comes to the pricing. The money they wanted was truly exorbitant. I leveled with them explaining that I was having health issues of my own and had to just do what was necessary- as they were literally trying to up-charge me on her healthcare. Can you imagine going to a doctor for an ear infection and they keep asking if you want to throw in a dental exam & enema 2 for the price of 1? It just does not make sense to capitalize on my cat’s stomach ache. It felt like I was at a used car lot. They also asked if I wanted her nails trimmed, I said yes, and they just literally didn’t do it.

The vet was fine, a little short but overall willing to work with me. And the vet tech was wonderful, I can’t remember her name. But the vet manager, or whatever woman was assisting me because no techs were available, really ruined my experience. I wasn’t going to write this review, but she asked me to leave one before I left, so I said I would.

Outstanding Veterinary Care, Dr. Azaini is the most outstanding Doctor, our Chucho certainly loves him as well as us.  Great service, very convenient for patients to take their fur coat animal I highly recommend it.

I’ve been coming here for a few years and seen lots of vets come and go. I’ve had generally good experiences. I’m not sure if I’ll return after my appointment today though.

I went in to have a bump on my dog inspected. I figured it would be pricier because the doctor suggested bloodwork and sampling, so I was confused when we left the room without having a cost breakdown done like normal. The staff at the front desk then told me my bill was over $800. Surprised, I asked for a breakdown of charges. They seemed surprised I asked. They called a vet assistant over to explain it. The vet assistant was immediately unfriendly became visibly frustrated as I asked questions to understand why undiscussed types of bloodwork were needed. I asked if any of the bloodwork we’d done a few months prior had overlap. I asked why the overlap wasn’t enough for diagnosing what we needed to. They explained this new bloodwork was more extensive and ultimately the bare minimum needed for ‘the charge package’.

I get prices being more than I expected. But I don’t get being treated like an annoyance for asking questions to know if everything was necessary. I don’t know why I wasn’t given a breakdown of service costs before they’re administered like I usually am. If I’d have known, I would have asked about my other options. When I was told, it was already too late. I love my dog to the moon and back and will take on as much credit card debt as needed, but that was half of my rent without warning.

This is the best vet I’ve ever been to the Dr Konishi and her nurses are absolutely amazing. They did surgery on my cat. I thought he was gonna die, but he’s in best health now ever and he is doing so well !  this is a great place to bring your dogs or cats . I really appreciate the team!
Great staff and service,  Dr Konishi , is hands doctor , very thorough
I had a great visit to Your Pets Wellness. The staff was friendly and the doctor was very informative. Highly recommend them!
Tito usually does well when he comes to the vet. The doctors are amazing. He was there for just a booster vaccine and it was pretty quick and easy.
They have been really nice to my dog for almost ten years.
Thank you for the 5-stars!
We are grateful for your feedback and appreciate your support!

Went here for almost two years but my most recent visit was uncomfortable and I believe they are engaging in predatory pricing practices and upcharging at any chance. Took my dog in for her annual wellness check and vaccines and while the technician's can helpful, the main doctor seems like he is UNCOMFORTABLE with animals. On top of this, I was told to schedule a dental appointment and not told that there was necessary blood work that I could have gotten done that day to schedule the appointment. When calling back to make the dental appointment, they advised me that I would have to come back for another appointment to get blood work done. Based on most recent reviews there seems to be change in ownership within the practice that has decreased the quality.
i have an anxious german shepherd and Bobby was so helpful, understanding, and patient with her. he was helpful and transparent! i will only schedule visits when Bobby is there. thank you!

Ever since Dr. Dory sold the practice this place is not the same. I barely felt any genuine love for animals in this place. The staff was filled with new faces (a sign of high turnover) for both techs and doctors. I love my dog, but at the same time I'm not rich. I'd like transparency about the cost of things before recommending work that isn't 100% necessary. I'd atleast appreciate some insight, reasoning, and conversation regarding certain recommendations or courses of actions. But none of those existed in my last visit, simply felt like a minute clinic that was trying to get me in and out. I've been going here for 8 years so it's sad to say that I'm now exploring alternatives.

I sent my friend a coupon for a free exam  DIRECTLY FROM yourpetswellness, and she was charged an additional $40, because their exams used to cost $90 but now they're $130. Which is fine, just say $90 off your first exam, or honor what the coupon said? Shady practice, and I've stopped recommending them to my friends which is sad because I used to love them!

I brought my cats here for the first time 4 years ago and loved it! The vet was so kind and gentle and really listened to me about their health and I never felt judged. I brought my cat back in for her annual check up and shots which cost $300+, and they looked genuinely shocked and disappointed I refused to spend an additional $300 for blood work that day. The doctor barely spoke to me, man handled my cat a little and I was charged over $100 more than my last visit, and they didnt explain the cost addition. They either have new ownership or have just gone downhill, but I don't think people should go to this vet anymore.
We greatly appreciate your 5-star rating! Thank you for choosing Your Pets Wellness for your pet's healthcare needs. We just absolutely love Yogi!

Just established my dog here as a patient as we just moved. Everyone in the office was extremely kind and friendly to me and Lilly. The vet we saw was absolutely lovely. Answered all questions thoroughly and was fantastic with Lilly. I feel very confident in Lilly having excellent care here.

Sadly, but predictably, private equity is ruining another business category. This time it’s the pet healthcare industry. We have three 16 year old cats and we now dread having to bring them to the vet as it’s usually a $300+ expenditure as soon as you hit the door. In the past 5 years alone the price of caring for our pets has doubled for the same service and same amount of visits. We used to like this place and on an individual level the people are nice. But every time we go it’s a different doctor and more expensive tests. It’s really sad because after our cats pass we probably won’t adopt any new pets as it’s just too expensive now. Unrestrained and unregulated greed has come to ruin another industry.
They were very nice and Curtis with me and my pet they explained everything to me and I thank them so much

Was really excited to take my just-adopted pup to his first vet appointment, and was excited to see they had a free first visit for new clients. I went in with confirmation from the staff it would be a free visit (of course I understood if my pup needed anything special outside of a wellness exam it would cost money). When asked about my new dog and how he was doing, I mentioned that he has a sensitive stomach just for them to be aware of. I was then told that “because he has these other issues, it no longer makes the appointment a wellness exam and therefore not a free visit”. Essentially, they scammed me and anyone else who experienced this. Because I voiced out loud that there was anything I wanted them to be aware of (bear in mind they did not do anything to treat this in any way, it was a regular wellness exam) they used that against a new patient. My pup was also terrified of the vet, hid under my chair the entire time, and they didn’t seem to care or want to ensure he felt comfortable. It was a very fast check on him with no attempt at getting to know him as a new patient, their way of a rug pull to make money under the guise of a free visit for new patients. Really sad to experience as a first time pet owner who really just wants to make sure my pup has the best care possible.
Your positive feedback is greatly appreciated.
Every experience is fantastic. Out of all of the animal health care clinics that we've been customers of, Your Pets Wellness has been the best one.

Truly despicable practice that will use any technicality to upcharge and evade helping your dog. I am fighting a brain disease and was late bringing my dog in for a recheck who is fighting several health problems himself. I explained my …

I'm updating the rating. This use to be the best location for our Senior cats. In the last year Dr. Dory has sold the practice. They weren't transparent about this information and the care changed drastically. The new doctors we saw was …
This place goes above and beyond. I moved to the western suburbs after living close but still go back to here.
